summary: Full backend + frontend test of RE/MAX Active Broker. 22/22 pytest cases passed (auth, properties CRUD+filters, agents CRUD, contact/messages, upload+serve, stats). Frontend e2e verified: homepage hero+stats+3 featured cards, /nemovitosti shows 6 cards and filter prodej narrows to 4, property detail opens with gallery+inquiry form+agent info, /tym shows 5 agents, /kontakt submits and shows Czech success toast with map iframe present, /admin redirects unauth users to /admin/login, login redirects to /admin, dashboard stats render (6/5/2/2), Properties/Agents/Messages tabs and Add-Property modal all work.
critical_code_review_comments: Storage helpers (init_storage/put_object/get_object) use module-level requests with global state — fine but could race on cold start; init is wrapped in try/except at startup so non-blocking.

send_notification_email is fire-and-forget with asyncio.create_task — RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally empty per problem statement; degraded path verified (contact still stores to DB and returns Czech success).
JWT cookie is set with samesite=none secure=true — required because frontend and backend are on same external host via ingress; verified login cookie persists across requests.
Admin seed updates password if env value changes (idempotent) — verified credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md work.
MongoDB _id is correctly stripped from all list/get endpoints via projection.
No rate-limiting / brute force lockout implemented on /api/auth/login — only relevant if hardening is required; not in playbook test scope for this fresh build.
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seeds 5 agents + 6 properties on empty DB. Tests create and delete TEST_ prefixed data inline (no residue).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all 22 critical API paths and is reusable for regression. Upload test will skip gracefully if storage init fails. Frontend testids confirmed: nav-link-properties, hero-cta-contact, property-card-{id}, properties-grid, filter-deal-{prodej|pronajem}, contact-* fields, login-email/password/submit, admin-tab-properties/agents/messages, add-property-btn, save-property-btn.
